title: Route a replacement sensor through the frame, connect M8, reinstall M3 screw, and re-start the operator station
summary: Route a replacement sensor through the frame, connect the M8 connection, reinstall the M3 button-head screw, reinstall any removed grommets, and re-start the operator station.
when_to_use: Use when a replacement sensor must be installed by routing it through the frame, securing it with the M8 connection and M3 button-head screw, and then re-starting the operator station.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: performs the physical sensor routing/connection/screw/grommet reinstallation and re-starts the operator station.
safety_notes: The provided evidence references LOTO in other maintenance figures/sections, but this specific sensor-routing/restart excerpt does not explicitly state LOTO. If your site procedure requires LOTO for sensor replacement work, follow that site requirement.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the sensor frame and M8 connector
Tools needed are not fully listed in the provided excerpt; use the manual’s sensor tool list for the specific sensor type being replaced
Operator station access to perform the referenced 'Starting The Operator Station' procedure

access_required: Physical access to the sensor frame and M8 connector
external_references: OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual v3, section 7.3.2.1.2 Installation (sensor wiring routing) and the referenced 'Starting The Operator Station' procedure on page 66

visual_references.description: A-Axis PCA connections diagram showing sensor wire routing around the gearbox and the PCA connection point; also references re-start of the operator station.

Z-Axis CLINK connections diagram showing sensor wire routing through the column and out the lower grommet into the control box, and plugging into I/O1, DI6, or DI7; also references re-start of the operator station.

steps.title: Tape the replacement sensor to the M8 connector to route it through the frame
steps.purpose: Use the old sensor as a pull-through method so the replacement sensor can be routed through the frame without excessive force.
steps.instruction: Tape the replacement sensor to the M8 connector so the old sensor can be used to route the new sensor through the frame.
steps.expected_result: The replacement sensor is taped to the M8 connector in a way that allows the old sensor to be used to pull/route the new sensor through the frame.
steps.healthy_condition: The replacement sensor can be routed without excessive force (no binding during pull-through).
steps.failure_condition: The sensor cannot be routed through the frame without excessive force.

actions.label: Tape replacement sensor to M8 connector
actions.exact_action: Tape the replacement sensor to the M8 connector so the old sensor can be used to route the new sensor through the frame.

stop_or_escalate_if: Sensor cannot be routed through the frame without excessive force.

steps.title: Pull the sensor out
steps.purpose: Remove the old sensor after it has been used to route the replacement sensor through the frame.
steps.expected_result: The old sensor is pulled out after routing the replacement sensor through the frame.
steps.healthy_condition: Replacement sensor remains routed through the frame after the old sensor is removed.
steps.failure_condition: Replacement sensor does not remain routed correctly (binding, misrouting, or inability to proceed to connection).

steps.title: Route the sensor through the frame
steps.purpose: Ensure the replacement sensor is positioned correctly through the frame for proper connection and operation.
steps.instruction: Route the sensor through the frame.
steps.expected_result: The sensor is routed through the frame.
steps.healthy_condition: Sensor routing is complete and does not require excessive force to position.
steps.failure_condition: Sensor cannot be routed through the frame without excessive force.

actions.label: Route sensor through frame
actions.exact_action: Route the sensor through the frame.

stop_or_escalate_if: Sensor cannot be routed through the frame without excessive force.

steps.title: Connect the M8 connection and re-install the M3 button-head screw
steps.purpose: Secure the sensor electrically/mechanically using the specified M8 connection and M3 button-head screw.
steps.instruction: Connect the M8 connection and re-install the M3 button-head screw.
steps.expected_result: The M8 connection is connected and the M3 button-head screw is reinstalled.
steps.healthy_condition: M3 button-head screw is installed at the specified location and the M8 connection is fully connected (no loose connection).
steps.failure_condition: M8 connection cannot be connected properly or M3 button-head screw cannot be reinstalled.

actions.label: Connect M8 and reinstall M3 screw
actions.exact_action: Connect the M8 connection and re-install the M3 button-head screw.

steps.title: Re-install any removed grommets
steps.purpose: Restore wire strain relief/sealing by reinstalling grommets that were removed to route the sensor.
steps.healthy_condition: Grommets are seated in the frame openings and the routed sensor wiring passes through them correctly.

steps.title: Re-start the operator station
steps.purpose: Bring the operator station back online so the system can recognize the newly installed sensor.
steps.instruction: Re-start the operator station (referenced as 'Starting The Operator Station' on page 66).
steps.expected_result: The operator station is restarted using the manual’s referenced procedure.
steps.healthy_condition: Operator station restart completes successfully and the system proceeds past the restart state (no restart failure).
steps.failure_condition: Operator station cannot be re-started using the referenced procedure.

actions.label: Restart operator station
actions.exact_action: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

stop_or_escalate_if: Operator station cannot be re-started using the referenced procedure.

success_criteria: Replacement sensor is routed through the frame.
healthy_conditions: Sensor routing is complete without excessive force.
M8 connection is fully connected and M3 button-head screw is installed.
Grommets are seated and wiring is properly managed through them.
failure_conditions: Sensor cannot be routed through the frame without excessive force.
Operator station cannot be re-started using the referenced procedure.
escalation_guidance: If the sensor cannot be routed without excessive force, or grommets cannot be reinstalled, stop and escalate.
If the operator station cannot be re-started using the referenced procedure, stop and escalate.
